additional_info.subject: ID0382297-DC/Si-D/UK[170001887] - No SCB connection CRM:00315001856
additional_info.body:
Hi Jason,
After you reached on site today, we weren't able to bring the charger to operation. But with the old CFAST it was possible to reach 70% → could reach failsafe mode.
We checked the network scan and found that Router 1 was not in the network but we could connect directly to it.
As you noticed, the WAN and LAN cables were swapped due to the customer's experiments on ELMS.
After putting the cables in the correct spot it's working again. Now you will proceed with the update of the charger.
Please let me know if I can close the ticket.
Best regards,
Francisco
